standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers the complete-intersection property of the completed local rings to the scheme-level lci notion and gives unramifiedness of Z over k.

core_obligations: Direction (2) => (1) (proof lines 4714-4730): points of Z are closed with finite separable residue fields; O_{X,x} is Cohen-Macaulay of dimension 1, hence depth 1, so x is a node by lemma-nodal; off Z the morphism is smooth by the Fitting-ideal smoothness lemma.

Direction (1), first half (proof lines 4733-4748): X is geometrically reduced at closed points, hence smooth on a dense open; Z is a closed set of closed points and X - Z -> Spec(k) is smooth, in particular a local complete intersection there.

Direction (1), second half (proof lines 4749-4760): for x in Z, O_{Z,x} = kappa(x) with kappa(x)/k separable, so Z -> Spec(k) is unramified; and by part (3) of lemma-nodal-algebraic the completed local ring O_{X,x} is a complete intersection, which agrees with the scheme-level lci notion via dpa-lemma-check-lci-agrees.
proof_roadmap: Assume the Fitting condition: derive closedness, CM depth 1 and nodality at Z, smoothness outside.
Assume nodality: get the dense smooth open and identify Z as its closed complement.
Show X - Z is lci by the smooth-syntomic implication.
Show Z is unramified and each O_{X,x} is a complete intersection via the nodal algebra normal form, closing with the notion-agreement lemmas.
difficulty_reason: The lemma equates the geometric node condition with an lci-plus-unramified-Fitting condition (statement lines 4699-4710). The proof (lines 4712-4760) is a two-direction reference chain in which each implication still has a real hinge: the depth computation making the Fitting points nodes, the dense-smooth-open argument, the unramifiedness of Z, and the transfer of the completed complete-intersection property to the scheme-level notion. The author prefaces it with an editorial remark urging the reader to find their own proof; the steps themselves are all present. H2: systematic assembly of earlier results with the hinges correctly ordered.
